about: What a run reads with no network: files cut from the checked files of sources.json by cut.sh, committed in this directory, each fixed by size and SHA-256. A photograph is NASA's file unchanged, so its SHA-256 is the one sources.json fixes; a cut names the item it was cut from and how.

files.cut: PDF pages 317 to 319, the page objects copied unchanged

item.title: Apollo 11 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription (GOSS NET 1), July 1969: the scanned typewritten pages, pages 317 to 319
item.role: the pages the eyes read with no network: mission time 04 06 43 35 to 04 06 48 10, the end of the descent and the landing

files.cut: the entries typed 04 06 43 00 to 04 06 48 59, byte for byte

item.title: Apollo 11 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription, typed from the same pages (Apollo Lunar Surface Journal, a NASA history publication), 04 06 43 00 to 04 06 48 59
item.role: ground truth for the mission times read off pages 317 to 319; never shown to the eyes

files.cut: seconds 1206 to 1224, VP9 in WebM at the source size, no audio

item.title: Apollo 11 25th anniversary B-roll (NASA Kennedy Space Center, KSC-19690716-MH-NAS01-0001-Apollo_11_Historical_Footage_and_Broll-DVC_1560, preview rendition): the mission's film footage in seven cuts; cut 3 'Lunar orbit and descent' holds the lunar module's separation and the descent through Eagle's window, cut 4 'On the Moon' the 16 mm film from Eagle's window of the first steps, seconds 1206 to 1224
item.role: the lunar surface through Eagle's window, read in three windows of 6 s
